description: For a partial elementary map \(f:A\to B\), an \(L(A)\)-formula \(\varphi(\bar x)\), and a target assignment \(\bar b\), the renamed formula \(\varphi^f(\bar b)\) holds in \(N_B\) exactly when the original native formula obtained by making the names free holds in \(N\) with parameter assignment \(a\mapsto f(a)\) and variable assignment \(\bar b\).
